title: "Objectives & prerequisites"

---

## Learning objectives

::: {.callout-note title="Learning objectives"}
- Write a single **Rule** in YAML.
- Run the Parser and read the internal representation it produces.
- Use the Composer to turn the parsed Rule into a working
  `hello-world-pico` artifact.
- Explain each stage of the Rules → Parser → Composer → Pico pipeline in
  your own words.
:::

## Prerequisites

::: {.callout-note title="Prerequisites"}
- A working shell (bash, zsh, or fish).
- A text editor and comfort reading YAML.
- Completion of the
  [Pico · Part 1 · Introduction](../../courses/pico/part-1/01-introduction/index.qmd)
  lesson (or equivalent).
:::

## Environment

- Operating system: macOS, Linux, or WSL.
- Required tools: shell + text editor. No additional runtime is required
  for this lab.
- Estimated time: **30–45 minutes**.

## Related lessons

- [Pico · Part 1 · Introduction](../../courses/pico/part-1/01-introduction/index.qmd)
  — introduces the vocabulary this lab uses.
- Future lessons in [Part 2](../../courses/pico/part-2/index.qmd) reuse the
  `hello-world-pico` produced here.
